prompt:
FOUR animation frames of ONE object, in a single horizontal row, evenly spaced, with WIDE EMPTY BLACK GAPS between them. All four the same size, aligned to the same invisible ground line, each complete and uncropped.

PERSPECTIVE — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT. Strict FLAT SIDE ELEVATION, like a technical elevation drawing or a flat cardboard cutout viewed dead-on from directly across the room at the same height. You see ONLY the FRONT FACE.
- The TOP of the object is a single horizontal EDGE, one line. It is NOT a visible surface. You cannot see the top of anything.
- Any circular feature must appear as a THIN HORIZONTAL LINE or a flat front-facing circle. NEVER an ellipse, NEVER an oval, NEVER a circle seen at an angle.
- NO isometric. NO three-quarter view. NO receding side faces. NO visible depth on the left or right. NO vanishing points. NO foreshortening.
If you can see the top surface, the drawing is WRONG.

THE OBJECT — a SNAPSHOT STATION: a save point that fuses a Shinto shrine with a computer terminal. Seen flat from the front:
- A bright red #E01F26 TORII GATE frames the whole object: two vertical pillars with a curved top rail sweeping up at both ends and a straight second beam below it. Dark red #8F1116 on the shaded inner edges. Weathered, chipped, with a few small dark cracks.
- Set BETWEEN the pillars, a CRT terminal in a dark grey #4A5568 housing with a chunky bezel, a glowing cyan #35C6F4 screen showing horizontal scanlines and a few rows of abstract glyph text, and two small status lights on the bezel.
- Beneath the terminal, a squat weathered stone base, grey, with a narrow inset offering ledge and thin cables running down from the terminal into the base.
- A twisted shimenawa straw rope is strung across between the two pillars above the terminal, with small white paper zigzag shide streamers hanging from it.

THE FOUR FRAMES — a looping idle animation. The object does not move; only the light does:
1. Screen lit, one cyan scanline near the TOP of the screen, two small green #C6F02A spirit motes hovering above the torii.
2. The scanline has swept to the UPPER MIDDLE of the screen, motes drifted higher.
3. The scanline at the LOWER MIDDLE, screen slightly brighter, three motes.
4. The scanline near the BOTTOM, one mote fading out at the top.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels on a strict grid, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners aesthetic — saturated neon against deep shadow, bold flat colour blocking.

BACKGROUND: PURE BLACK #000000 everywhere. NO grid lines, NO borders, NO ground line, NO labels, NO readable text, NO watermark.

PALETTE: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #00E5FF #8FE8FF #FF2D95 #FFD400 #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568.
